steps.rationale: Review RV-1 passed. Two critical hard-coded AWS credentials in config.py lines 4-5; they need rotation and removal.
Review RV-2 passed. Three high findings: debug mode, disabled TLS verification, wildcard CORS with credentials.

v1 challenges on the advisory count and the version recommendation were addressed in v2. The one remaining challenge (RV-5-C1) is minor and about wording: the recommendation says to upgrade to the highest fixed version, although the lowest fixed version is named. It doesn't affect the findings, so I accept the step and note the wording.
Review RV-4 passed. Two medium findings: unpinned express with no lockfile, and unpinned gunicorn.

summary: The repository has serious problems. It has hard-coded AWS credentials (critical) and three high-severity insecure configurations. It also has known-vulnerable lodash and requests versions, plus unpinned dependencies with no lockfiles. Fix the secrets first: rotate them and remove them from the repository. Then fix the config and upgrade the dependencies.
